family: sentiment-v1 (separate from, and does not alter, the frozen 132-family in walkforward-protocol.json)
purpose: Test whether narrative sentiment/open-interest rules show a net-of-cost directional effect on BTCUSDT, and whether any adjustable threshold level can honestly be labelled 'proven'. No efficacy claim; not trading advice.

data.source: research/recorder partitions (forward-only, public Bitget USDT-FUTURES, sampled REST, 5m series)

symbols.AAPLUSDT: only open_interest is recorded (no long/short series, no_data 40054): stock-like contracts may only use OI and price/volume rules (R3, R4, R5 price part); no long/short rule is run on them and no AAPLUSDT run is part of this protocol version

data.grid_5m: recorder records bucketed by available_ms (local receive clock, no look-ahead); last value per 5m bucket; buckets lacking any required series are dropped, never forward-filled
data.ratio_units: long_ratio/short_ratio normalised to fractions (values > 1 are read as percent)

horizon.entry: close of the bar after the signal bar
horizon.event_spacing: non-overlapping: next event only after the previous exit

R3_healthy_trend_rising_oi.signal: 12-bar price return >= +0.5% AND 12-bar OI change >= T

R5_exhaustion.signal: 12-bar price return >= +T AND 12-bar mean taker buy share <= 0.50

multiplicity.holm: Holm step-down over all 24 (rule, level) hypotheses at alpha 0.05, even though only 5 selected levels are confirmed (deliberately conservative: the grid counts)

gates_before_any_run.otherwise: runner prints verdict NOT_READY (INCONCLUSIVE) and exits 2; nothing is selected or evaluated

split.confirmation: all later days, untouched until selection is frozen
split.selection: only on discovery: level with highest mean net return at 22bp among levels with >= 30 events; ties -> lower grid index; if its net mean <= 0 the rule stays narrative_default (no candidate)
split.freeze: selected level + sha256 recorded before confirmation data is read
split.no_reselection: confirmation evaluates the frozen level exactly once per rule (ledger); a repeat is refused; failure is final for this data

costs_bp_round_trip.note: assumptions, not measured execution costs; measured recorder spreads/fees may only be reported alongside

status_ladder.candidate: selected on discovery with positive net mean at primary cost and discovery plateau
status_ladder.proven: ONLY if all hold on confirmation of the frozen level: >= 30 non-overlapping events; mean net return at 22bp >= 5bp; same sign gross effect for every adjacent grid level (plateau, not a spike; discovery neighbours also retain >= 50% of the selected gross effect); Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 over 24; >= 20 day blocks
status_ladder.not_proven: any criterion fails: explicit final outcome

inference.method: day-block sign-flip permutation on block means of net signed returns, non-overlapping events, exact enumeration refused above/below declared block limits (refuse INCONCLUSIVE if < 20 blocks)
inference.validity_caveat: The repo's day-block sign-flip tests (practical-inference v1-v3) FAILED size control under serial dependence. This test is NOT validated; p-values are descriptive. A 'proven' label means the pre-declared screen was passed, not that the effect is real, stable or tradable, until a calibration passes on this data type.

reporting: outcomes only as narrative_default/candidate/proven/not_proven; no efficacy claim, no trading advice
reproduction: python3 -m research.sentiment_rules RECORDER_DIR   (dry, finite; exits 2 while gates unmet)
